info.name: JobLoom — CSP Fix Verification (Automated)
info.description:
After-fix collection. Keep the original missing-header evidence collection unchanged.

Import and Run all 3 requests in the saved order with one iteration. No login, environment or data setup is needed for localhost:5173. All 10 positive assertions should pass. The final response Visualization provides one screenshot showing all three resolved URLs, status 200, CSP verification, and the reviewed full policy. If the Runner does not show Visualization, inspect response Headers and Test Results or run 01-03 through the Runner with response retention enabled.

Default expected policy is independently generated from the shared frontend policy builder for development with API http://localhost:3000/api and Jitsi meet.jit.si. For preview/production or different configured origins, change csp_frontend_url and set csp_expected_policy from the independently reviewed builder output, not from the response under test. A nonempty report-only header is not sufficient.

The collection automatically saves csp_fix_verdict and csp_fix_evidence_json. Run-local state prevents stale previous-run results. Passing tests confirm header delivery/configuration, not XSS elimination or production deployment. Screenshot capture is manual.

CLI: newman run postman/collections/CSP-Fix-Verification.postman_collection.json --timeout-request 15000 --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export /tmp/jobloom-csp-fixed.json

Guide: postman/guides/fix/CSP-HEADER-NOT-SET-VERIFICATION-RESULTS.md
